item.title: Crews continue repairs in Farmington Hills as Novi residents picked up water at Public Works
item.description: Water pressure has started to return in Novi and Walled Lake after a massive water main break in Farmington Hills on Saturday morning, the Great Lakes Water Authority tells us.

item.title: EMU men's basketball & head coach Stan Heath agree to part ways
item.description: Eastern Michigan University men's basketball and head coach Stan Heath have agreed to part ways, the program announced on Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Union City High School becomes hub of hope after deadly Southwest Michigan tornadoes
item.description: Union City High School has transformed into a community resource center in the days following deadly tornadoes that tore through Southwest Michigan, with volunteers arriving to help neighbors in need.
